shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat/curved stone surface
horizontal registers or bands of carved content
repeated small incised units arranged in rows
justification: A depicts a figural scene: two human figures in profile, one standing with a staff and one seated on a legged throne raising a cup, with fine incised detail of garments, hair and beard. B shows no figures at all, only horizontal bands of repeated rectangular/blocky sign-like units in low relief; the only shared content is the generic device of horizontal registers of carved elements.
